# Willy on the Wire

> Willy on the Wire is a live band from Bozeman, Montana. We play rock, blues, soul, and funk. We are Montana's soundtrack for a good time.

## Site

- Home: https://willyonthewire.com
- Shows: https://willyonthewire.com/#shows
- Booking: https://willyonthewire.com/#booking
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/willyonthewire/
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@WillyOnTheWire
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/p/Willy-on-the-Wire-61577985041444/

## Who we are

Willy on the Wire is a Bozeman live band. We play rock, blues, soul, and funk, and we put our own weight on the classics. The set is built to get a room moving and keep it there.

Regular rooms include The Haufbrau, the Eagles Club, and Tune Up in Bozeman, plus Chico Hot Springs and Big Sky.

## What we offer

We book as a solo, duo, trio, four-piece, five-piece, and beyond. That covers a Bozeman bar, a Big Sky lodge, a festival, or a private party.

Wedding packages cover the ceremony, the cocktail hour, and the dance floor.

## Booking

To book Willy on the Wire, send the form at https://willyonthewire.com/#booking with the date, the room, and the lineup you want. You can also DM @willyonthewire on Instagram.

Service area: Bozeman, Big Sky, and Montana.
